risk: The golden set covers only six figures
why_the_checks_miss_it: a report can get an uncovered figure wrong and still pass V2
mitigation: add a golden row each time a reader finds an error

risk: The human sample is one rater
why_the_checks_miss_it: one person's habits become the standard the judge is measured against
mitigation: add a second rater and report how often the two agree

risk: The judge and the reporter can share a blind spot
why_the_checks_miss_it: if both models misread the same table both scores look fine
mitigation: keep a person reading a random sample of reports
